Class AbstractCompiler

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.plugins.AbstractPlugin
net.emustudio.emulib.plugins.compiler.AbstractCompiler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Compiler, Plugin
public abstract class AbstractCompiler extends AbstractPlugin implements Compiler
Compiler base. Implements listeners and the compilation workflow:
  1. listeners are notified about the start; title and version are reported
  2. output path is resolved (replacing source file extension by getOutputExtension())
  3. compile(Path, Path) is called; CompileException or any other exception is reported as an error
  4. listeners are notified about the finish

    • compile

      public final void compile(Path inputPath, Optional<Path> outputPath)
      Description copied from interface: Compiler
      Compile given input file.

      If output path is not given, it is derived by replacing the source file extension of the input path. Usually a successfully compiled program is loaded in memory.

      Specified by:

      Parameters:
